description.sl: so + pridevnik: so cold that we stayed in; such a + samostalnik: such a cold day, ne *so cold day*; brez a pri neštevnem: such cold weather. Dve dejstvi: whereas. Poudarek: It was Jack who found her; What I need is a cup of tea.
description.de: so + Adjektiv: so cold that we stayed in; such a + Nomen: such a cold day, nicht *so cold day*; ohne a bei Unzählbarem: such cold weather. Zwei Tatsachen: whereas. Betonung: It was Jack who found her; What I need is a cup of tea.
description.it: so + aggettivo: so cold that we stayed in; such a + nome: such a cold day, non *so cold day*; senza a con ciò che non si conta: such cold weather. Due fatti: whereas. L'enfasi: It was Jack who found her; What I need is a cup of tea.
description.en: so + an adjective: so cold that we stayed in; such a + a noun: such a cold day; no a with what you can't count: such cold weather. Two facts: whereas. Emphasis: It was Jack who found her; What I need is a cup of tea.

exercises.prompt: It was ___ day that we stayed by the fire.

explain.sl:
**such a + (pridevnik) + samostalnik; so samo s pridevnikom**
- **It was such a cold day.** · Bil je tako mrzel dan.
- **It was so cold.** · Bilo je tako mrzlo.
explain.de:
**such a + (Adjektiv) + Nomen; so nur mit dem Adjektiv**
- **It was such a cold day.** · Es war so ein kalter Tag.
- **It was so cold.** · Es war so kalt.
explain.it:
**such a + (aggettivo) + nome; so solo con l'aggettivo**
- **It was such a cold day.** · Era una giornata così fredda.
- **It was so cold.** · Faceva così freddo.
explain.en:
**such a + (an adjective) + a noun; so with the adjective alone**
- **It was such a cold day.**
- **It was so cold.**

exercises.text: ___ Mr Tyson likes the mill, Alfie likes the fells.
accept: Whereas
While
Whilst

explain.sl:
**whereas, while: dve dejstvi drugo ob drugem; lahko stoji tudi na začetku**
- **Jack likes the fell, whereas Sam likes the town.** · Jack ima rad hribe, Sam pa mesto.
explain.de:
**whereas, while: zwei Tatsachen nebeneinander; es kann auch am Anfang stehen**
- **Jack likes the fell, whereas Sam likes the town.** · Jack mag die Berge, Sam dagegen die Stadt.
explain.it:
**whereas, while: due fatti uno accanto all'altro; può stare anche all'inizio**
- **Jack likes the fell, whereas Sam likes the town.** · A Jack piace il monte, mentre a Sam piace la città.
explain.en:
**whereas, while: two facts side by side; it can come first too**
- **Jack likes the fell, whereas Sam likes the town.**

instruction.sl: Fill the gap · Dopolni: Izgubljeno jagnje je našel Alfie.
instruction.de: Fill the gap · Ergänze: Es war Alfie, der das verlorene Lamm gefunden hat.
instruction.it: Fill the gap · Completa: È stato Alfie a trovare l'agnello perso.
instruction.en: Fill the gap: It was Alfie who found the lost lamb.

exercises.text: It was Alfie ___ found the lost lamb.
accept: who
that

explain.sl:
**It was + kar je pomembno + who (oseba) ali that (karkoli). Govori se tudi what; pisava hoče who**
- **It was Alfie who found it.** · Našel ga je Alfie.
explain.de:
**It was + das Wichtige + who (Person) oder that (alles). Gesprochen auch what; die Schrift will who**
- **It was Alfie who found it.** · Alfie war es, der es gefunden hat.
explain.it:
**It was + ciò che conta + who (persona) o that (qualsiasi cosa). A voce anche what; lo scritto vuole who**
- **It was Alfie who found it.** · È stato Alfie a trovarlo.
explain.en:
**It was + what matters + who (a person) or that (anything). People also say what; writing wants who**
- **It was Alfie who found it.**

instruction.sl: Fill the gap · Dopolni: Kar potrebujem, je skodelica čaja.

instruction.en: Fill the gap: What I need is a cup of tea.

exercises.text: What I need ___ a cup of tea.
accept: is

hint.en: What + a clause, then the verb.

explain.sl:
**What + stavek + is: pomembno pride na konec, brez vejice pred is**
- **What I need is a cup of tea.** · Kar potrebujem, je skodelica čaja.
explain.de:
**What + Satz + is: das Wichtige kommt ans Ende, kein Komma vor is**
- **What I need is a cup of tea.** · Was ich brauche, ist eine Tasse Tee.
explain.it:
**What + frase + is: ciò che conta va alla fine, niente virgola prima di is**
- **What I need is a cup of tea.** · Quello che mi serve è una tazza di tè.
explain.en:
**What + a clause + is: what matters comes last, no comma before is**
- **What I need is a cup of tea.**
